name: wiki
description: Memory and lore. Karpathy LLM-Wiki 3-layer under the neutral .llmwiki/ root (insight + wiki + raw): bootstrap-wiki, ingest-finding (reversible diff-log + cross-page update), lint-wiki (four wiki-rot modes), plaud-note-taking (PLAUD Whisper transcript correction into .llmwiki/raw/transcripts/), plus five hooks — stale-page hint, post-commit ingest hint, session-start lint hint, Stop-time capture of ingest candidates, and the next session's drain. mem0 fleet operations — fleet-scan (per-app noise / fragmentation / config posture, read-only) and cleanup (backup-then-delete behind a dry-run default and a per-app confirmation gate).
